adatas = {}

os.listdir('../../data/Leblay_Single_Cell/GSE199359_RAW/')

for file_name in os.listdir('../../data/Leblay_Single_Cell/GSE199359_RAW/'):
    adata = sc.read_10x_h5('../../data/Leblay_Single_Cell/GSE199359_RAW/' + file_name) 
    adata.var_names_make_unique()
    treatment_status_str = file_name[17:21].replace('_', "")
    treatment_status = [treatment_status_str for i in range(len(adata.obs))]
    adata.obs['treatment_status'] = treatment_status
    print(treatment_status_str)
    adatas[file_name[11: 16]] = adata

adata = ad.concat(adatas, label='sample')

Feature Selection¶

Dimensionality Reduction¶

  • Allows us to see what principle components explain the majority of the variance
    • Looks like PC1-5
  • We can also use PCA to see if variation is being driven by our QC variables
    • It looks like we need to filter mitochondrial genes
In [20]:
sc.tl.pca(adata)
sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio(adata, n_pcs=50, log=True)
In [21]:
sc.pl.pca(adata, color=['t11_14', 'pct_counts_mt', 'sample', 'patient_id'], size=2, ncols=2)

Exploratory Differential Expression Analysis¶

  • Compare expression between pre and post treatment samples (then with t11;14 phenotypes)
  • Color UMAP by most strongly differentially expressed genes
In [27]:
# im gonna remove some features for the sake of differential expression analysis
# I don't think we're concerned with cell type annotation because these should all be tumor cells
# when I update this workflow I'll filter high counts of these genes including IGH
adata = adata[:, ~adata.var_names.str.startswith(("MT-", "RPS", "RPL", "IGH", "IGK", "IGL"))].copy()

pre_res = gp.prerank(rnk=diff_expr_res, gene_sets=[hallmark_gmt], threads=8, min_size=5, max_size=1000, outdir=None, seed=4)
pre_res.res2d = pre_res.res2d.sort_values(by="NES")
pre_res.res2d = pre_res.res2d.sort_values("FDR q-val").drop_duplicates(subset="Term")
pre_res.res2d = pre_res.res2d.sort_values(by="NES")
